title: wfw-1995-usenet-intercontinental
label: Inferno

won.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard: won a battle-royal-qualified final by count-out over Lenny Rose.

how: Won a twelve-man Battle Royal and its count-out final to become the WFW's first-ever Intercontinental Champion.
note: Still recognized as champion two days later, successfully defending in a non-title match on the fed's own 'Power Zone' broadcast.

title: wfw-1995-usenet-world-heavyweight
label: The Ultimate Fighting Machine

won.source: The fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard: pinned champion Johnny Banger.

how: Pinned champion Johnny "the rebel" Banger for the WFW World Championship.
note: Still champion two days later, successfully defending (non-title) on the fed's own 'Power Zone' broadcast.

title: wfw-1995-usenet-world-heavyweight
label: Johnny "the rebel" Banger

won.source: Billed the reigning WFW World Champion coming into the fed's own 'Summernight Powerslam' supercard; no title-change document for his own win survives in the held record.

how: Not recovered — held the title coming into the held record.
note: Lost the title to the Ultimate Fighting Machine on 5 July 1995.
